# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V2040 unused_value"
description: "A non-final expression statement produces a non-Unit value that is dropped."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2040` prints this explanation offline.

A non-final expression statement produces a non-`Unit` value that is dropped. This catches
forgotten reassignments such as `List.push(xs, 1)` (design §8.1).

Wrong:

```sakura
List.push(xs, 1)
```

Fixed:

```sakura
xs = List.push(xs, 1)      // or: let _ = …
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2040_unused_value.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V2040_unused_value.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn grow() -> List<Int> {
  var xs = [1]
  List.push(xs, 2)
  xs
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2040_unused_value.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V2040_unused_value.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
fn grow() -> List<Int> {
  var xs = [1]
  xs = List.push(xs, 2)
  xs
}
```
